checkpoint: Minimum selection sparse cross-entropy, including epoch zero; joint restore of classifier and gate
primary_metric: accuracy; paired task-minus-raw differences in percentage points
scope: Exploratory internal holdout on official TRAIN only. Not a TASK EEG reproduction, not an official FordA test score, not proof of physical denoising.
fixed_ssa_rule: Per-sample smallest prefix explaining >=90% trajectory singular-value squared energy. No labels or held-out tuning.
scale: One scalar mean/std fitted on fit input values only; applied to all raw samples before SSA. No separate output normalization.
budget: Common pretrained initialization and branch sample order per seed; equal classifier updates; gates have extra head updates and compute, not equal FLOPs.
stop_rule: Complete all prespecified seeds and branches; do not change backbone, rank, epochs or split in response to assessment scores. Official TEST remains unopened.
